info.description: Self-hosted document archive with a first-class MCP server

post.description: Looks for the names and aliases of every person in the text of every document, without the LLM, and links what it finds. Documents whose people were set by hand are left alone. This also runs by itself whenever a person is created, renamed or given or losing an alias; call it to repeat the pass on request. List the documents of the person with a search filtered by `people`.

AdminSettingsPatch.description: Partial update for runtime instance settings.

AdminSettingsView.description: Complete administrator view returned by `GET /api/v1/settings` and `PATCH /api/v1/settings`.

CalendarFeed.description: The feed as settings show it.

lead_days.description: Days before a due date the feed adds a "renew" event; 0 means it does not.

CreatedCalendarFeed.description: A freshly made or rotated feed. The secret and the address are in this response only.

url.description: The full address when `PAPERJAM_PUBLIC_URL` is set; otherwise the client prefixes the origin it reached the server on.

CreatedEmailSecret.description: Returned once when a new email intake secret is generated or rotated.

DocumentEvent.description: One audit log entry for a document.

DownloadLink.description: A download link as handed to a client.

DuplicateAttachment.description: An attachment whose exact bytes are already in the archive.

EmailIngestReport.description: Summary returned after processing one email.

EmailSettingsPatch.description: Partial update for inbound email settings.

EmailSettingsView.description: Public view of inbound email settings returned by the admin REST API.

ErrorResponse.description: The JSON error body returned on failure: `{"code", "message", "details"}`.

FeedView.description:
A user's calendar subscription as shown in settings. The secret is not
part of it: it exists in clear only in the response that made it.

FieldFilter.description:
`field.<key>` filter. `value` is read as a date (`YYYY-MM`,
`YYYY-MM-DD`; a bare year in a field that holds dates), a number, or text,
in that order.

value.description:
A date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM`, or a bare year on a field that holds
dates), a number or text.

Filters.description:
Structured filters (MCP and REST callers should not have to compose
query strings). Types, people and correspondents match any of the given
values; tags must all be present.

fields.description: Comparisons on typed fields, all of which must hold.

has_attention.description: Only documents that need (or do not need) attention.

attention.description:
The checks that failed on the document, e.g. `mrz_mismatch`; empty
when it needs no attention.

due_date.description:
When the document has to be renewed or replaced: its expiry date, or
for a Russian internal passport the birthday it is replaced at
(20 or 45). Absent for documents without one.

has_pages.description:
The document has page images and a thumbnail; false for a failed
document and for a plain-text file, whose image routes answer 404.

key_fields.description:
The type's summary fields that have a value, in the type's order
(without summary fields: the first few fields of the type). A JSON
object whose key order is the display order.

organizations.description: Names of the linked organizations, in role order.

snippet.description:
Plain text around the match with `<mark>…</mark>` highlights; every
other `<`, `>` and `&` is escaped.

trashed.description: The document is in the trash (only reachable with `include_trashed`).

InboxSettingsPatch.description: Partial update for watched inbox folder settings.

InboxSettingsView.description: Administrator view of watched inbox folder settings and recent rejections.

IngestedDocument.description: A document created or restored from an email attachment (or body).

LlmSettingsPatch.description: Partial update for runtime LLM settings.

LlmSettingsView.description: Administrator view of runtime LLM settings (never includes the API key).

label.description: A name to recognize the passkey by, such as the device.

show_details.description:
Show the summary and the extracted values next to the pages; the title,
type and date are always shown.

ttl.description: How long the link works; `15m` when omitted.

username.description:
Optional: limits the sign-in to this account's passkeys. Without it the
browser offers any paperjam passkey it holds.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

partial.description:
True when no document matched every word of the query, and these are
the ones that match some of them (the words were joined by OR).

cursor.description: Opaque; pass back `next_cursor` of the previous page.

filters.description: Structured filters, combined with the query by AND.

limit.description: Hits per page: at most 50, 20 when omitted.

query.description:
The query language: free text, `"exact phrase"`, `-negation`, `OR`,
parentheses, `type:`, `person:`, `from:`, `tag:`, `has:`, `date:`,
`added:`, `due:`, `local:` and `field.<key><op><value>`. `has:expiring`
finds documents due within 270 days or already past due. Empty or missing: no
text condition.

sort.description: Order of the hits; `relevance` when omitted.

SettingsSummary.description: Non-sensitive instance settings summary exposed to any signed-in user.

code.description: The setup code the server prints to its log at start-up.

display_name.description: Shown in the interface; defaults to the username.

ShareTtl.description: How long a share link works.

SkippedItem.description: An attachment or inline asset that was intentionally skipped.

local_only.description: Skip LLM enrichment and keep processing strictly local.

type_id.description: Document type ID to assign immediately.

UploadLink.description: A one-time upload link as handed to a client.

restored.description: True when the same bytes were in the trash and that document came back.
